decision_reason: ACTIVATE GCC narrowly: original nonstandard unsigned short 5/5/6 vs 5/3/8 bitfields compare sizeof(struct A) with sizeof(struct B), abort on mismatch, gated by short representing 65521. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS; constant-folded layout comparison is a source-size oracle, not field content/endianness coverage. KCC noopt cannot compile unsigned short bitfield GNU extension.

ACTIVATE with GCC optimized failures: original GCC __builtin_setjmp in buf, noinline sub2 calls __builtin_longjmp, dynamic __builtin_alloca stack buffer contains real strcpy("test") and after jump strcmp must remain equal or abort. GCC native PDP6 O0 PASS with real indirect jump and call/compare; O1/O2/Os each RUN_FAIL by __test_exit=1 (actual abort, not timeout), with generated indirect control transfer. KCC noopt LINK_FAIL on freestanding strcmp/longjmp-compatible dependencies. Record GCC semantic/fail/fail/fail, KCC no_test pending genuine support.

ACTIVATE GCC builtin standard names: original volatile int/long/long-long/intmax_t 0, +/-1 and +/-maximum, plus compile-time constants, use abs/labs/llabs/imaxabs; all runtime wrong values go to abort and constant-fold failures to link_failure/abort. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS, actual abort branches remain in O0/O2 assembly. KCC noopt cannot compile deployed limits.h and builtin dialect, so no KCC claimed.

ACTIVATE GCC explicitly named builtin abs/labs/llabs/imaxabs: volatile runtime extrema and constant-folded literals are checked across int/long/long-long/intmax_t, abort on mismatch, link_failure/abort for wrong constants. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS with reachable branches in O0/O2. KCC noopt missing limits.h and rejects GNU builtins; only GCC native profiles selected.

ACTIVATE GCC complex builtins: volatile float/double/long-double _Complex values 1+2i exercise conj/conjf/conjl and creal/cimag plus __builtin versions, and constant folds with real/imag exact abort checks. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS; emitted O0/O2 main retain numerous abort comparisons. KCC noopt rejects GNU _Complex syntax. Preserve exact checks and no false KCC support.

RETAIN original noreturn/link-only oracle. Volatile int i=0 guards tabort/texit/t_exit/t_Exit; all called functions deliberately contain link_failure after abort/exit/_exit. Lowercase-only __pdp10__ leaves _eexit(1) typo/reference active when GCC defines only __PDP10__, making GCC O0 LINK_FAIL, KCC noopt COMPILE_FAIL for undeclared _exit. Even after branch correction, exit-only without proving optimizer suppresses return paths would be vacuous. Preserve source and original semantics for later separate source adaptation/compilation.

RETAIN nonasserting prefetch smoke: original invokes __builtin_prefetch in legal rw/locality combinations from integer, enum and constant expressions, and returns exit(0) without checking codegen, side effects, returned values or machine operations. GCC PDP6 O0 passes but a no-prefetch target can reduce helpers to returns; KCC noopt linker rejects unimplemented __builtin_prefetch. Do not register a no-op as semantic success; later compile/codegen oracle.

RETAIN nonasserting prefetch address smoke: global/static/local/struct/array pointer forms are passed to builtin prefetch, but main has no assertions; for PDP6 with no hardware prefetch the no-op can eliminate all address effects and still return success. GCC PDP6 O0 PASS, KCC noopt LINK_FAIL on unimplemented builtin. Need explicit meaningful compile-only oracle or non-crash target policy before activation.

RETAIN nonasserting volatile prefetch smoke: volatile pointer/address forms passed to __builtin_prefetch, but main does not assert a fetched value, side effect, or count. GCC PDP6 O0 PASS on no-prefetch target and KCC noopt LINK_FAIL for missing builtin. Cannot infer working volatile prefetch semantics merely from exit(0); preserve original for later codegen/compile-only review.

ACTIVATE GCC prefetch side-effect regression: original 22 distinct checks of pre/post pointer/index increment/decrement, assignment and real getptr/getint function call counts are individually abort guarded, even when target has no actual prefetch instruction. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS; O2 main retains all 22 call-and-check branches and abort. KCC noopt LINK_FAIL because __builtin_prefetch not implemented; no KCC profile registered.
